verdict.rationale: An online tax services portal could plausibly offer event-triggered automation, such as an automatic payment when a bill is issued, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only manual actions (responding to notices, Quick Pay) and payments scheduled in advance, which is a date-based one-off action rather than a user-defined rule triggered by an event. Probes found no API or OpenAPI surface that could support programmatic triggers, so there is no documented capability here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
